# Trimology Notebook (trimology.onrender.com)

> Independent information and ordering website for Trimology, a once-daily capsule (30 per bottle, bottle labelled Trimology Weight, Advanced Weight Loss Support) the seller says combines resistant starch type 2 from potato starch, chicory root inulin, Clostridium butyricum, Akkermansia muciniphila and Bifidobacterium infantis, marketed to support gut health and weight management in adults. No amounts, strains or live counts are given and no Supplement Facts panel was supplied. 6 bottle pack $49 a bottle ($294); 2 and 3 bottle prices shown at checkout; 180-day money-back guarantee that needs an RMA, a return within 14 days and return shipping at the customer's cost, per the seller.

IMPORTANT: Trimology is a supplement, not a treatment for obesity, and it does not guarantee weight loss; no study of the finished capsule is shown, and reviews of probiotics for weight find small or no effects. Not FDA approved (supplements are not). Contains live bacteria (care with weak immunity or serious illness) and fermentable fibre (gas and bloating). Ask a doctor first with diabetes medicine, IBS, IBD, SIBO or a history of eating disorders. Adults 18+ only; pregnant or nursing people should consult a physician.

Not the maker's website. Contains affiliate links.
